Random Name Generator

Generate realistic first and last names for any gender and origin — International, Pakistani, Arabic, Western or Indian. Click any name to copy it.

Click any name to copy it to your clipboard. These are fictional, randomly combined names.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a gender filter and a name origin.
  2. Select how many names to generate.
  3. Click Generate Names.
  4. Click any name in the list to copy it to your clipboard.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are these real people’s names?

No. They are randomly combined from built-in first and last name lists, so any resemblance to a real person is a coincidence.

How many names can I generate?

You can generate 5, 10, 20 or 50 names at a time, and run the generator as often as you like.

What are these names good for?

Character names for stories and games, placeholder data for testing software, and naming ideas for projects.
